reason: Under the schedule lens the idea AS DESCRIBED fails, for three reasons. (a) The protocol it pre-registers cannot be met by 29 Sep 10:00 UTC with >= 70%. Parts (2) neutral relink probability and (3) leaf prune re-enable are gated on the H3 x138-tail lab, and the 'before/after GT distance of readmitted nodes' check for (1) also needs that lab. The sibling schedule verdict v_linking-on-x138_x138-tail-lab-headcoords_schedule.json refutes that lab as described: captures hold features for only 313,205 near-GT peaks of 4.83M (experiments/coordhead_retrain/out_full_P/report.txt L1), and the repair needs 13-16 GPU-h plus friend A, who has been silent since 24 Sep. P(lab gate passed in time) <= 0.3. (b) The idea says to ship only as a rider in the H1/H3 bundle, but both hosts are schedule-refuted (v_linking-on-x138_split-aware-flow-relink_schedule.json and v_linking-on-x138_x138-tail-lab-headcoords_schedule.json: feasible=false). (c) One of the two implementation routes it offers is the bug x138 documents: 'V1284 patch ordered first' sends the lowdet anchor count to 0. That is swallowed by the non-fatal try/except (exp56 cell 4, 'LOW-DETECTION DUMP SKIPPED'), which silently disables BOTH readmit and gapfill (x122 v1 lost them this way). Re-anchoring is also unnecessary: the V1284 patch adds `from v1284_coordinate_refinement import refine as _v1284_refine` at module top, so a call inside the lowdet replacement text resolves at runtime with the CURRENT order. Numbers check out: 1,337/121,777 = 1.10% readmit, 513 pruned leaves with >= 479 readmitted (CONTEXT.md L1511-1517); 1.6983 -> 1.5375 um on 179 videos (report.txt L104-105); leaf prune +0.0006 (CONTEXT L1324-1328). One mechanism is mis-stated. cell 0 sets READMIT_MIN_SCORE = 0.965 = det threshold, and _detect_cells_pooled is a threshold-independent max-pool local-max (tools/repo/scripts/predict_unet_transformer.py L256-286). So readmitted nodes are ILP-discarded ABOVE-threshold peaks that the head already refined before the ILP; readmit re-adds their unrefined int16 copy. Only gapfill peaks (0.5-0.965) are truly sub-threshold, and for them the head is out of distribution and unmeasured. In motion_relink_edges (exp56 cell 5 L519-540), prob 0.0 applies to EVERY pair outside the ILP solution, not only readmit pairs, so the median-prob rule in (2) is not 'purely geometric'. The mechanical part (1) is cheap (~2 h, zero runtime cost, no GPU beyond a shared ~0.5 GPU-h dummy run) and CAN be scored in time; it survives only in the reduced form below. Even then a scored probe carries no information about it: its effect is <= +0.0004 against LB noise 0.003.
fix_if_any: Ship (1) only, reduced, and drop (2)/(3) unless an x138 lab exists by 27 Sep 12:00 UTC. (i) New build_probe_kernel.py patch 'lowdetrefine' for --base x138 (today only divinsert/leafprune are allowed). Edit the 'lowdet peaks' replacement string in exp56 cell 4 in place, with no re-anchoring and the patch order unchanged (lowdet first, V1284 second). After `_lsc` is computed from the integer `_low`, when BIOHUB_LOWDET_REFINE=1: `_hi = _lsc >= 0.965; _lowf = _low.astype(np.float32); _lowf[_hi] = _v1284_refine(ds_path, t, _low[_hi], unet_out[:, f_idx])`, then append _lowf. That refines only the in-distribution >= 0.965 part (readmit), and there it reproduces the pre-ILP node coordinates exactly (same local-max peaks, same features). The 0.5-0.965 gapfill peaks stay unrefined because the head is OOD there. In 'lowdet write', skip the int16 cast when enabled. ENABLE=0 must be byte-identical. (ii) Because the dump patch is non-fatal, the probe must FAIL LOUDLY: make the dummy-log check require 'Low-detection dump applied' and per-video 'LOWDET <name>: N peaks' equal to exp56's N, and treat 'LOW-DETECTION DUMP SKIPPED' or 'gap filler idle' as a hard fail. (iii) Local tests in the container: apply both patch lists in order to tools/repo/scripts/predict_unet_transformer.py (anchor counts == 1, compile OK); CPU unit test that refine on the >= 0.965 subset equals refine on arr. (iv) Dummy gate: readmitted within +-10% of 1,337, gapfill counts within +-10%, no 'invalid V1284 displacement', no REPAIR FAILED, submission valid; compare with out_exp56 via cmp57.py on the user's machine. (v) Host it in ANY x138-based kernel already being rebuilt on 26-28 Sep (e.g. the x138 + DaughterNet-insertion F1 candidate or a coordhead/detector bundle), because H1/H3 will not exist. Never give it its own slot, and never count it toward the 0.99 plan. For (2), if it is ever revisited, use the readmitted node's real pre-ILP network probability via the candidate-edge cache, not a median, and only with a working x138 lab.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0000 to +0.0004 (central ~+0.0001) for the reduced (1); unobservable on the LB (noise 0.003). (2)/(3) are not shippable in time (no lab gate), so they contribute 0.
realistic_private_gain: +0.0000 to +0.0005 (central ~+0.0001). The geometry-only fix transfers; there is no confidence-leak risk because the >= 0.965 subset reproduces coordinates the head already produced.
